ontology.note: Existing ontology alignment; full configuration and port shape contracts remain to be defined.

changes.description: DR Congo's 26 provinces are chosen, applied and reopened in about a second each, where each took 5 to 7. The receipt names the shape by its GeoJSON's SHA-256; the dialog's summary counts several polygons. The Inspector moves out of app.ts.

evidence.note: Repository regression coverage exists; this release entry does not certify a widget independently. 0.8.0: tests/area-countries.test.mjs (4: the list read from a saved country; Gaborone to the border proposes Botswana and South Africa and the interior Botswana alone; half each on a square split by a straight border; the national outline's URL) and tests/area-countries.browser.mjs (found with shares, confirmed, applied; named by hand; a saved country as a list of one). Not checked by somebody else's code. 0.9.1: tests/study-area.test.mjs (an enclave starting on its hole's east edge is accepted, and refused without the hole; fails on 0.9.0's check) and tests/mers-from-scratch.browser.mjs (South Korea's 17 provinces as a study area); Chromium. 0.9.2: tests/boundary-source.test.mjs (South Korea, north korea, Vietnam resolve; Korea alone does not; the other names are all Natural Earth's where they differ). 0.9.3: tests/study-area.test.mjs (a district with a 1 m² part accepted and kept; 1 m² alone refused); Rwanda's 30 districts applied in tests/population-models-from-scratch.browser.mjs; Chromium. 0.9.4: tests/study-area.test.mjs (two holes meeting at a corner on the other's edge admitted, which 0.9.3 refused with Rwanda's message; a hole inside a hole still refused).
